children.textContent: Discover before-and-after smiles from The Dental Barns. Browse by treatment and clinician, and explore the treatment details, costs and duration behind each transformation.
Choose more than one to see combined treatments.

props.value:
Your first step is the Signature Assessment ✦ with Dr Keely. It combines Smile Design, a comprehensive examination and clinically appropriate diagnostics in one 90-minute appointment.

We discuss your itemised treatment plan and costs on the day. A personalised written report follows afterwards. Any treatment is priced separately, with no obligation to proceed.

If you would prefer to start with a conversation, a standalone Smile Design appointment gives you time to meet Dr Keely and the team, explore your options and decide on your next step.

We release a limited number of Smile Design appointments from time to time. Booking links are shared exclusively with our VIP Waitlist.

props.value:
Begin with a Signature Assessment ✦ at The Dental Barns. Your 90-minute appointment combines Smile Design, a comprehensive examination and clinically appropriate diagnostics.

Join The Dental Barns VIP for private access to the assessment appointments currently available. We will text you a secure booking link.

If you would prefer to start with a conversation, a standalone Smile Design appointment gives you time to meet Dr Keely and the team, explore your options and decide on your next step.

props.value: Located at the prestigious Blackbrook Barns, The Dental Barns is nestled in the countryside between Lichfield and Sutton Coldfield. Surrounded by historic rustic barns, rolling landscapes, and the calming flow of the Black Brook.
